1.t: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—

2.t: created humans from a clinging clot

3.t: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous

5.t: taught humanity what they knew not

6.t: Most certainly, one exceeds all bounds

7.t: once they think they are self-sufficient

8.t: ˹But˺ surely to your Lord is the return ˹of all˺

9.t: Have you seen the man who prevents

13.t: What if that ˹man˺ persists in denial and turns away

14.t: Does he not know that Allah sees ˹all˺

15.t: But no! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag him by the forelock—
15.tr: Kalla la-il lam yantahi la-nasfa'am bin-nasiyah

17.t: So let him call his associates

18.t: We will call the wardens of Hell

19.t: Again, no! Never obey him ˹O Prophet˺! Rather, ˹continue to˺ prostrate and draw near ˹to Allah˺
